prompt: 我要执行 my_debug_flow 工作流，.dvv 目录已存在且有旧文件，请准备执行环境
expected_output: 归档旧文件到 .dvv/archived/my_debug_flow/{timestamp}/，创建新的目录结构和日志文件

assertions.name: legacy_log_archived

assertions.name: legacy_plans_archived

assertions.name: new_log_created
